notes.title: Pop Island v1.19.349
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33041285/4890aadcaeae76ddd93521556d50e504f5ad7eac.png[/img]
Dear All, this update is big :
[list]
[*]Pop Island Colors are back -in the pop island 2009 spirit. It returns to its own style.
[*]AI for AI lovers. If you are at this skill of code, you can play with reinforcement learning. The AI library has been seriously upgraded. Six new AI projects has been added. It becomes serious.
[*]A tons of updates on functions, libs and games. Too much to list one by one.
[/list]

PLUS if you'll get an android smartphone, you could now code on the go. Just search Pop Island on the Google Play Store. This pocket version is really handy.
